svg.title: Option 1f: the construction, as networks
svg.text: the stimulus set is a line of directions; each unit it drives reads a different point on it

text.tspan: Units that fire together get stronger links.

svg.text: no stimulus, yet one shared signal (arousal, running) pumps a group of units

text.tspan: Seven units light up, all copying one signal:
A subset of the units in (a).

svg.text: the units and links in (a) that are not in (b)
Subtracting the pictures is the idea.
Baseline PCA does it to covariance:
PCA on (a) alone returns the biggest
cluster, which is the redundant one.
